rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: At the sitting of 10 August 1996 (Great Hall, 11:00, chaired by G. N. Seleznev), deputy N. I. Ryzhkov speaks of 'Борис Николаевич Ельцин, инаугурация которого состоялась вчера', and V. V. Zhirinovsky, in a rhetorical aside, refers to the deputies having taken part 'yesterday' in the President's inauguration ('Если вчера мы участвовали в инаугурации Президента').
rows.locator: Speeches of Zhirinovsky V. V. and Ryzhkov N. I. in the debate on Chernomyrdin's nomination
